conditions.timing: Complete reconciliation after an actual browser restart; native release and flush included. Separate diagnostic arms. Main-thread TaskDuration uses threadTicks; renderer ProcessTime is optional; Browser/storage CPU excluded.
conditions.storage: At least 2 GiB free before each serial arm. Each owned profile is sampled between phases against 256 MiB; recorded high-water marks are not continuous peaks. No database dumps or native vaults.
conditions.oracle: Exact unchanged per-arm source heads, independent fresh-host compiler vs authenticated cached semantic replay, quiet tail, later edit/reclamation and actual second restart. No equal physical-cache or production-vault gain claim.
